# env-var-name: environment variable names and dotted configuration keys, not their values.
# a long screaming-snake-case name is a key. the credential would be on the other side of it.
CONFIG_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=production-eu-central
if runtime.environment["ACME_WIDGET_SERVICE_ACCOUNT"] is None:
- name: ACME_WIDGET_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT_OVERRIDE
env_keys = ["ACME_WIDGET_DATABASE_HOST", "ACME_WIDGET_DATABASE_PORT"]
DEFAULT_CONFIGURATION_DIRECTORY=/etc/acme/widget
process.env.ACME_WIDGET_FEATURE_FLAGS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
export ACME_WIDGET_LOG_FORMAT=json-lines
    ${ACME_WIDGET_RETRY_BACKOFF_MILLISECONDS:-2500}
widget.telemetry.exporter.otlp.endpoint.timeout=10000
ACME_WIDGET_SCHEDULER_MAX_CONCURRENT_BATCHES=64
ACME_WIDGET_TENANT_ID={UUID}
